meta.name: pm-skill-creator
meta.description: Design a new PM skill through guided conversation. Use when you have raw content or an idea and want to shape it into a compliant skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过对话将想法转化为合规技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有原始内容或想法，想把它塑造成一个合规的技能。
copy.tagline_en: Turn raw ideas into compliant skills through guided conversation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have raw content or an idea and want to shape it into a compliant skill.

howto.what: 当用户想将某个想法、笔记或框架变成技能时，该技能先了解起点，再通过最多五轮自适应提问确定技能类型、范围和内容，最后生成一份含必需章节的 SKILL.md 草稿供用户审阅。
howto.when: 当用户有想做成技能的原始内容或想法（如笔记、框架），或直接要求创建新技能时触发。之后它会让你选引导式、粘贴内容或直接猜测，再逐题推进。

say.text: 帮我把定价分层的框架整理成一个技能
say.note: 它会从你的框架出发开始提问。

say.text: 我有 workshop 的笔记，想做成一个技能
say.note: 它会分析内容并和你确认类型与结构。

say.text: 帮我设计一个新技能，我知道主题但不知道怎么组织
say.note: 它会按引导流程一步步定出技能结构。

howto.what_en: When you ask to shape an idea, notes, or framework into a skill, it leads you through up to five adaptive questions and then outputs a complete, repo-compliant SKILL.md draft.
howto.when_en: Triggers whenever you have raw content or an idea and want to shape it into a skill, or when you ask to create a new skill. It then offers three entry modes and starts asking.

say_en.text: Turn my pricing-tiers framework into a skill.
say_en.note: It will ask the first guided question about your raw material.

say_en.text: I have workshop notes and want to make a skill from them.
say_en.note: It will treat the notes as your starting context.

say_en.text: Help me create a new skill; I know the topic but not the structure.
say_en.note: It will walk you through scope and structure questions.
